Act as the review sub-agent for this task.

You are a Senior Code Reviewer. Re-review a revised implementation plan + spec after 13 prior findings were fixed. Plan/spec review only (no implementation code exists yet). Verify each claimed fix and hunt for remaining gaps. Be strict.

FILES (repo root C:\Project\ninfs-mcp, read both fully first): docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-08-ninfs-mcp.md (rev2), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-ninfs-mcp-design.md (rev3).

PRIOR REVIEW VERDICT WAS 'No' WITH 13 FINDINGS. CLAIMED FIXES IN THIS REVISION:
1. (Critical) Resident-mount model: no communicate-wait; spawn(Popen stdout=DEVNULL/stderr=PIPE/stdin=DEVNULL) -> readiness poll (200ms x 10s) -> terminate/wait/kill; stdout discarded incl. ID0/Key lines.
2. InternalMount(kind/mount_point/proc/handle_id) ownership record; Task 2 creates, Task 3 uses.
3. _RESIDUALS separated from public registry; unmount order exefs->ncch->sdtitle->sd; retry_residuals; atexit cleanup_all in server startup.
4. Full public response key sets fixed (detect 4 keys / mount 2 / find 5 / extract 4 / unmount 3); Task 4 tests exact sets; ID->object resolution in server layer.
5. Title resolution order corrected: select on live SD mount first (update-first, TMD tiebreak update>version>name), then spawn sdtitle->ncch->exefs; CXI = largest .cxi.
6. Abnormal paths assigned: WinFsp precondition (Task 2), decompress-failure vs not-needed vs entry-absent (Task 3), title-absent early return.
7. Path checks split: format rejection (dotdot components even if resolving inside, absolute, drive, UNC, device) + containment via realpath; mixed / and \ allowed as normal relative.
8. Task 1 reordered: packaging first, then pip install, then tests; CLI flag verification (all 5 CLIs, --decompress-code, ro flag) recorded before Task 2 uses args.
9. NINFS_WORKSPACE required-absolute + creation assigned to server startup (Task 4); parent mkdir(parents=True) in extract (Task 3).
10. Assertions made precise (call order, exact key sets, terminate-before-kill order, mock-based).
11. Per-commit security-audit quick + final independent review added as executable steps.
12-13. Concrete smoke (ninfs-mcp --help exit 0); self-review rewritten.

SPEC CONTEXT: Windows+WinFsp, stdio, ninfs CLI via subprocess only, 5 tools, read-only enforced, common sanitizer everywhere, workspace-only dest, ambiguous multi-SD error, mocked tests only, Native execution, 4 tasks TDD.

CHECKS: (a) each of the 13 fixes is real and sufficient; (b) no new contradictions introduced (esp. resident-proc model vs readiness/timeout/cleanup wording across sections); (c) step granularity one-action-per-step; (d) type/key consistency across tasks; (e) remaining spec-silent behaviors a reasonable user would hit.

OUTPUT: ### Strengths; ### Issues (#### Critical/Important/Minor with file:line+why+fix); ### Recommendations; ### Assessment (Ready: Yes/No/With fixes + reason). Before verdict list out-of-scope items one line each with reason. Read-only: mutate nothing, spawn no subagents.
